Hi Emily — thanks for sending these over and welcome.

Short answer up front: typical vendor onboarding checklist below; if you can return items 1–5 we can usually validate and queue PO activation within 3–7 business days (barring contract/legal review or unusual tax issues).

Required items for vendor setup:
1) Completed supplier onboarding form (I can send our template)
2) W-9 (or foreign tax docs if applicable)
3) Bank details (voided check or bank letter)
4) Certificate of insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured where relevant
5) Supplier diversity self-ID or certificate (you already provided — thank you)
6) Modern slavery / human trafficking attestation (short form)
7) Sustainability scorecard (you provided — we'll include in the file)

Optional but helpful:
- SOC2 or security attestation if you will be processing sensitive data
- References for production integrations

I've attached our vendor intake checklist and the vendor portal link where you can upload docs securely. For the modern slavery attestation, we have a one-page form — if you prefer to provide your corporate policy and a signed representative attestation that will work too.

Next steps:
- I attached the intake checklist (Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist_REDWOOD.pdf) and created a vendor portal record: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/SUSTAINCO-794
- Please upload W-9, bank stub, and COI to the portal. Once I confirm receipt we'll kick the PO request to finance.
- I'll loop in Marissa (Supplier Diversity) and Karthik (Legal/Contracts) to confirm any follow-up questions.

If you'd like, let's do a 20-min sync to run through the items — I'm available Wed 7/15 10:00–11:00 PT.
